describe: make the player jump, or add gravity
guide: Jumping needs a vertical speed: make velocity_y = 0 and GRAVITY and JUMP_SPEED constants above the loop. Every frame add GRAVITY to velocity_y and velocity_y to the player's y. When the player reaches the ground, stop there and set velocity_y = 0. When SPACE is pressed and the player is on the ground, set velocity_y = -JUMP_SPEED.
Remove the up and down arrow movement, or it will fight the gravity.
